rows.component_basis: liquid AgO0.5 one-cation formula-unit mole fraction; two units per Ag2O parent
rows.parent_standard_state: engine parent P672-Ag2O-LFS is a liquid-from-solid construction with a hypothetical 500 K fusion anchor; Norris gamma is relative to Assal et al. (1997) liquid AgO0.5, ln Kf(1923 K) = -6.493, not this engine parent
rows.source_citation: Norris, C. Ashley (2016), "Volatilities of Trace Elements in Silicate Melts", DPhil thesis, University of Oxford
rows.source_locator: Table 4.16 (PDF p. 170, Ch. 4 p. 140), mean 0.080 and range 0.033–0.26 at 1923 K; Table 4.9 (PDF p. 128) gives n/2=0.5 and Ag+; §4.9.1 identifies AgO0.5. The Table 4.16 heading prints AgO1.5, so its oxide label is resolved from Table 4.9 and §4.9.1.
limitations: inferred from metal–silicate partitioning (Kf + γ-in-Fe model); not a measured activity
single temperature 1923 K; the point is the Table 4.16 mean and the band is its printed min–max range
Section 4.11.2 judges all reported activity coefficients accurate within an order of magnitude; this bound is not used to widen the Table 4.16 band
